import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement

/-! Exact determinant update and attachment of two matrix blocks by one
bidirected edge. The field lemma only uses invertibility of one block;
polynomial continuation removes this restriction for characteristic matrices. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Ring
variable {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

lemma add_single_eq_updateRow (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    A + Matrix.single i j c = A.updateRow i (A i + Pi.single j c) := by
  ext k l
  by_cases h : k = i
  · subst k
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

/-- The cofactor determinant identity at every matrix, singular or not. -/
theorem det_add_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A + Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det + c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [add_single_eq_updateRow, Matrix.det_updateRow_add]
  have hs : (Pi.single j c : ι → R) = c • Pi.single j 1 := by
    funext k
    simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  rw [hs, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul, ← Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  simp

theorem det_sub_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A - Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det - c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.single_neg, det_add_single]
  ring

end Ring

section Field
variable {K ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
  [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- Attach arbitrary blocks through just the specified pair of directed entries.
The diagonals are NOT recomputed; existing exit rates remain in each block. -/
def edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K) :
    Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) K :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.single i j a) (Matrix.single j i f) B

/-- Exact edge-attachment determinant when one block has nonzero determinant;
no invertibility or nonsingularity of the other block is needed. -/
theorem det_edgeJoin_of_right_ne_zero
    (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K)
    (hB : B.det ≠ 0) :
    (edgeJoin A B i j a f).det = A.det * B.det - a*f*A.adjugate i i*B.adjugate j j := by
  letI : Invertible B := Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hB)
  rw [edgeJoin, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.single_mul_mul_single, det_sub_single]
  rw [Matrix.inv_def]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

end Field
end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.EdgeDeterminant
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Coeff
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots

/-! Characteristic-polynomial attachment by a bidirected edge.
No eigenvalue simplicity, positive rate, or nonzero-rate assumption is needed.
All denominators are removed by a polynomial identity argument. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- Actual diagonal cofactor of the characteristic matrix, before cancellation. -/
def diagonalCofactor (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) : ℝ[X] :=
  (Matrix.charmatrix A).adjugate i i

lemma eval_charmatrix (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (Polynomial.evalRingHom s).mapMatrix (Matrix.charmatrix A) =
      Matrix.scalar ι s - A := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h]

lemma eval_diagonalCofactor (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) (s : ℝ) :
    (diagonalCofactor A i).eval s = (Matrix.scalar ι s - A).adjugate i i := by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => M i i)
    ((Polynomial.evalRingHom s).map_adjugate (Matrix.charmatrix A))
  simpa only [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom,
    eval_charmatrix, diagonalCofactor] using h

lemma scalar_sub_edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar (ι ⊕ κ) s - edgeJoin A B i j a f =
      edgeJoin (Matrix.scalar ι s - A) (Matrix.scalar κ s - B) i j (-a) (-f) := by
  ext u v
  cases u <;> cases v <;>
    simp [edgeJoin, Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.single_apply]

/-- Every nonzero real polynomial is nonzero at infinitely many points. -/
lemma infinite_nonroots (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Set.Infinite {s : ℝ | p.eval s ≠ 0} := by
  simpa only [Set.compl_setOf, Polynomial.IsRoot] using
    (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp).infinite_compl

/-- Exact characteristic recurrence for attachment by one bidirected edge.
The original block diagonals, including exit rates, are kept unchanged. -/
theorem charpoly_edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :
    (edgeJoin A B i j a f).charpoly =
      A.charpoly * B.charpoly - C (a*f) * diagonalCofactor A i * diagonalCofactor B j := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots B.charpoly (Matrix.charpoly_monic B).ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hd : (Matrix.scalar κ s - B).det ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have h := det_edgeJoin_of_right_ne_zero (Matrix.scalar ι s - A)
    (Matrix.scalar κ s - B) i j (-a) (-f) hd
  simpa only [Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_sub_edgeJoin, Polynomial.eval_sub,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_diagonalCofactor, neg_mul_neg] using h

end HydrologyTree
